title: How to Look Better Without Changing Your Face

scenes.narration: Strangers judge your face in about a tenth of a second.
scenes.art: a young adult walking down a busy city street while many floating cartoon eyes glance at them from all directions

scenes.narration: But they're not just reading your bones. They're reading signals you can change.
scenes.art: a friendly young adult face shown like a scientific diagram, glowing circles highlighting the skin, the eyes, the smile and the shoulders
a young adult sleeping peacefully in a cozy bed under a big crescent moon, soft blue night light

scenes.narration: In one experiment, people photographed after a sleepless night were rated less healthy and less attractive.
scenes.art: two side by side portraits of the same young adult, left one well rested and bright, right one tired with droopy eyelids and pale skin

scenes.narration: A follow-up study found what gives it away: droopier eyelids, darker circles and paler skin.
scenes.art: a close-up comparison of two pairs of cartoon eyes, left bright and rested, right tired with droopy eyelids and dark circles underneath

scenes.narration: Signal two: even skin tone. More even skin is read as younger and healthier.
scenes.art: a close up of a smiling young adult cheek with a magnifying glass showing smooth even skin tone, clean scientific style

scenes.narration: The boring fix? Daily sunscreen. In a four year trial, daily users showed no detectable increase in skin aging.
scenes.art: a cheerful young adult applying sunscreen in front of a bright cartoon sun with a protective shield bubble around their face
scenes.cite: Hughes et al., Annals of Internal Medicine 2013

scenes.narration: Signal three: posture. In a speed-dating study, open, expansive body language got more yeses.
scenes.art: two young adults at a cafe table on a speed date, one sitting open and relaxed with arms wide, confident and smiling

scenes.narration: Easy test: in your next photo, uncross your arms, drop your shoulders and take up a little more space.
scenes.art: a young adult posing for a phone photo with relaxed open shoulders and uncrossed arms, a friend holding the phone, sunny park

scenes.narration: Signal four: a real smile, the kind that reaches your eyes. It's rated as more genuine and more attractive.
scenes.art: a young adult with a big genuine smile that makes the eyes crinkle, warm sparkles around the face

scenes.narration: Your bones set the frame. But sleep, skin, posture and a real smile are things you control.
scenes.art: a young adult standing tall and confident on a small stage with a soft spotlight, four small glowing orbs orbiting around them

scenes.narration: So which one do you skip the most?

post.title: Look better without changing your face 👀
post.description:
Strangers judge your face in about 0.1 seconds, but they're reading more than bone structure. 4 science-backed signals you can actually change: sleep, even skin, posture and a real smile.

Sources:
Willis & Todorov (2006) Psychological Science
Axelsson et al. (2010) BMJ
Sundelin et al. (2013) SLEEP
Matts et al. (2007) J Am Acad Dermatol
Hughes et al. (2013) Annals of Internal Medicine
Vacharkulksemsuk et al. (2016) PNAS
Gunnery & Ruben (2016) Cognition and Emotion
